summary:
TerraTwin is an AI-powered 3D interactive platform designed to systematically discover Earth analogs for Lunar and Martian environments. We developed a unified data pipeline that breaks down agency silos, integrating fragmented datasets from NASA, ESA, CSA, and JAXA into a single accessible dashboard.

To address the challenge, our solution goes beyond mere visual resemblance. TerraTwin20% Temperature. Researchers can interactively explore these matches on a high-fidelity CesiumJS 3D globe, complete with detailed metric breakdowns highlighting exactly where the analogy works and where it falls short.

This innovation is critical because it replaces a grueling, manual data-referencing process that historically took weeks with an automated search taking mere seconds. By instantly pinpointing scientifically precise terrestrial test sites, TerraTwin massively reduces mission planning costs and accelerates the safe testing of Artemis rovers, habitats, and crew operations. Ultimately, TerraTwin transforms our own planet into the ultimate training ground for humanity’s next giant leap.
